newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Siam City Bank to launch $100 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Siam City Bank to launch $100 mln FRCD.

text.p: Siam City Bank Public Co Ltd, acting through its Cayman Islands branch, plans to launch a US$100 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue next week, arranger Chase Manhattan Asia said on Wednesday.
The certificates have a tenor of three years.
The issue is off the borrower's US$1.0 billion Medium-Term Note Programme.
A group of co-arrangers is being formed.
The other arrangers are Asahi Finance Hongkong, Dresdner (South East Asia) and Berliner Bank.
Chase Manhattan Asia is the bookrunner.
Pricing of the issue has not been finalised, but bankers expect the certificates to pay more than Siam City's previous issue, a floating rate note that was launched in January 1996.

That US$100 million issue, which had a maturity of five years with a put option in year three, paid a coupon of 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate and, with fees, an all-in return of 53.3 basis points.
